# LinkedIn Email Finder

> Paste a LinkedIn profile URL you already have. The personal email comes back only when the match is exact. A miss is free.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $30 per 1,000 emails found. You pay when an email is returned. A row with no exact email is not charged.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-personal-email-finder
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-personal-email-finder`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You have the profile and you need the personal mailbox.

## Use something else when

You have the email and you need the profile. Use Reverse Email Lookup. That lookup is also the check: the same profile URL coming back means the address belongs to that person.

## Page

- Personal email from a LinkedIn profile URL: docs/personal-email-from-linkedin.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
